opp_summary.name: Ricecookers
opp_summary.note: Deceptive 0-3 record! Every loss was a competitive 4th-quarter battle (lost by 9 to Misfits 2, by 5 to Latto Talent, and by 3 [55-58] to TMT).

common_opponents.insight: Ricecookers outrebounded TMT 31-24 and hit 8 threes (#4 Eugene 3/5, #12 AJ 3/5, #22 Sim 2/7), but TMT held #3 Dustin to 5/11 FG (0/3 3PT) and forced 7 turnovers.
Campbell United blew out Misfits 2 by +17 behind 11 made 3PTs (#7 Nick Switzer 6/8 3PT, #44 Christian Raslowsky 4/6 3PT) and dominant interior play (#4 Adam Fecteau 12p/10r/5a, #16 Chris 11p/8r).

personnel.name: Dustin
personnel.tendency: Relentless paint driver & transition finisher; scored 23 vs Latto Talent but dropped to 12 PTS (5/11 FG, 0/3 3PT) vs TMT when walled off inside.
personnel.matchup_plan: Primary on-ball: #4 Adam Fecteau / #9 Aaron. Go UNDER high screens, wall up vertically in the lane (#44 Christian / #16 Chris), and make him shoot contested pull-up 3s (0/3 in Wk3).

personnel.name: Sim
personnel.splits: 28 PTS, 18 REB (10 REB vs TMT) • 5x 3PM (2/7 3PT in Wk3)
personnel.tendency: Pop-out big who trails in transition for top-of-the-key 3s (7 3PA vs TMT) and crashes the glass hard (10 REB in Wk3).
personnel.matchup_plan: Matchup: #44 Christian Raslowsky / #16 Chris. Don't lose him on the pick-and-pop at the top of the arc, then box him out immediately.

personnel.name: Nate
personnel.tendency: Most disciplined decision-maker on Ricecookers (7 AST, 0 TO in 3 games). Hits 1-2 rhythm 3s every game (2/4 3PT vs TMT).
personnel.matchup_plan: Matchup: #7 Nick Switzer / #31 Evan Kovarik. Stay attached on drive-and-kick relocations.

personnel.name: Aaron
personnel.splits: 22 PTS (16 in Wk1, 4 in Wk2, 2 in Wk3) • 11 Personal Fouls (3.7 PF/G) • 4 TO
personnel.tendency: Physical downhill wing who gambles and reaches constantly on defense (fouled 4 times in Wk1, 4 times in Wk2, 3 times in Wk3) and went 1/6 FG (0/2 3PT) vs TMT.
personnel.matchup_plan: Attack him off the bounce early (#31 Evan Kovarik / #4 Adam Fecteau) to put him in foul trouble and get Campbell United into the bonus!

personnel.name: Eugene
personnel.splits: 17 PTS in 2 GP • 5x 3PM (3/5 3PT, 11 PTS, 3 STL vs TMT)
personnel.tendency: Pure catch-and-shoot sniper who caught fire against TMT (3/5 3PT) and plays passing lanes (3 STL).
personnel.matchup_plan: Run him off the 3-point line—no help off Eugene on weak-side corners.

personnel.name: AJ
personnel.splits: 15 PTS in 2 GP • 3/5 3PT (9 PTS) vs TMT
personnel.tendency: 71% of his field-goal attempts vs TMT were 3-pointers (3/5 3PT, 0/2 2PT).
personnel.matchup_plan: Hard closeout with high hands; force him to put the ball on the deck where he went 0/2 inside the arc.

personnel.name: Toby Flores
personnel.splits: 16 PTS (4x 3PM, 2x 2PM), 3 REB, 3 STL vs Latto Talent
personnel.tendency: If active on Nov 8, instant green-light shooter from deep who also jumps passing lanes (3 steals).
personnel.matchup_plan: Identify immediately in warmups; treat as a primary 3PT threat from tip-off.

personnel.name: Dylan
personnel.splits: 0 PTS, 15 REB in 3 GP (58 total mins) • 0 FGA, 0 FTA!
personnel.tendency: Has played 58 minutes across all 3 games without taking a single shot (0 FGA)! Exclusively sets screens and hunts offensive rebounds.
personnel.matchup_plan: HUGE TACTICAL EDGE: Whoever guards #11 Dylan (#24 George / #22 Matt / #16 Chris / #44 Christian) can sag 10 feet into the paint as a free rover to wall off #3 Dustin's drives!

tactical_keys.title: Sag Completely Off #11 Dylan (0 FGA in 3 Games) to Wall Off #3 Dustin
tactical_keys.detail: #11 Dylan has played 58 minutes without attempting a single field goal (0 FGA). Use Dylan's defender as a free help-side rim protector in the paint whenever #3 Dustin (17.7 PPG) drives!

tactical_keys.title: Dominate the Paint & Glass (+10.7 RPG Advantage)
tactical_keys.detail: Campbell United averages 39.7 RPG (#44 Christian Raslowsky 8.7 RPG, #16 Chris 8.0 RPG, #4 Adam Fecteau 6.0 RPG) vs Ricecookers' 29.0 RPG. Crash the offensive glass and punish their smaller lineups inside.

tactical_keys.title: Run #4 Eugene (3/5 3PT), #12 AJ (3/5 3PT) & #22 Sim Off the Arc
tactical_keys.detail: Against TMT, Ricecookers shot 8/22 (36.4%) from 3PT (#4 Eugene 3/5, #12 AJ 3/5, #22 Sim 2/7) while going just 12/26 (46%) on 2PTs. Never help off #4 Eugene or #12 AJ on the perimeter—help comes strictly from #11 Dylan or #1 Aaron's man.

tactical_keys.title: Attack #1 Aaron Early to Trigger Foul Trouble (3.7 Fouls/Game)
tactical_keys.detail: #1 Aaron has committed 11 fouls in 3 games (4, 4, and 3) and went 1/6 FG vs TMT. Go right at him with #31 Evan Kovarik, #4 Adam Fecteau, and #44 Christian Raslowsky to get into the bonus early.

tactical_keys.title: Unleash Campbell United's Inside-Out 3PT Barrage
tactical_keys.detail: Coming off an 11-three explosion vs Misfits 2 (#7 Nick Switzer 6/8 3PT, #44 Christian Raslowsky 4/6 3PT) and #4 Adam Fecteau's 3 triples vs TMT, use post touches for #44 Christian and #16 Chris to collapse Ricecookers' defense for wide-open kick-out 3s.

opp_summary.name: Latto Talent
opp_summary.note: Revenge & #1 Seed Showdown! Latto Talent beat CU 73-45 in the Mar 1 Winter '26 Final behind #2 Troy (23p/11r, who JUST returned in Wk 4!) and added superstar #9 Diallo Holmes (20.3 PPG, 10.0 RPG, 87.5% FT). NOTE: LT has trailed or tied at halftime in ALL 4 games (-4.5 PPG in 1H, +5.5 PPG in 2H), and Weeks 1-2 box scores logged makes only (Weeks 3-4 full tracking: 38.7% FG, 27.9% 3PT).

common_opponents.insight: Campbell United dominated Misfits 2 by +17 (11x 3PM + #4 Adam 3 dunks), whereas Latto Talent was tied 33-33 at halftime and tied 59-59 with 2:20 left before #3 Mahaan's corner 3PT & #1 Sean's lane drive sealed it.
Razor-close parity across both teams! Against Ricecookers, LT trailed 30-35 at half and needed #9 Diallo Holmes going 10/10 FT (27 PTS, 16 REB) when #1 Aaron & #6 Raj traded foul trouble.

BLUEPRINT TO BEAT LATTO TALENT: Sapa Boys blitzed LT 39-31 in the 1st Half and walled off #9 Diallo Holmes inside WITHOUT fouling — holding Diallo to 4/14 FG (1/6 2PT!) and just 3/4 FT (14 PTS) while forcing #1 Sean into 2/7 3PT!

In March, #2 Troy feasted in the paint for 23 PTS (10x 2PM) & 11 REB alongside #1 Sean (11 PTS), #5 Brandon (9 PTS), and #6 Raj. Troy just made his Holiday '26 debut in Week 4 (6 REB, 2 STL, 1 BLK) — CU's upgraded size (#44 Christian, #4 Adam, #16 Chris, #20 Shane) is built for payback!

tactical_keys.title: EXECUTE THE 'SAPA BOYS WALL' ON #9 DIALLO HOLMES — ZERO REACH-IN FOULS (87.5% FT!)
tactical_keys.detail: #9 Diallo Holmes accounts for 32.4% of Latto Talent's scoring (20.3 PPG, 10.0 RPG, 3.3 APG, 21/24 FT = 87.5%). When Ricecookers fouled him, he went 10/10 FT for 27 PTS. When Sapa Boys showed a vertical chest wall without reaching, he shot 1/6 on 2PTs (4/14 FG, 14 PTS). Run him off catch-and-shoot 3s (10x 3PM, 37.5% in Wks 3-4) into #44 Christian / #4 Adam / #16 Chris verticality, and gang-rebound his misses!

tactical_keys.title: BLOW UP THE #1 SEAN -> #9 DIALLO TWO-MAN ENGINE & CUT OFF SEAN'S RIGHT-HAND PAINT DRIVES
tactical_keys.detail: #1 Sean Steven (11.5 PPG, 2.5 APG) has 7 direct assists to #9 Diallo — their #1 halfcourt trigger! Over Weeks 3-4 full tracking, Sean is a lethal 6/6 (100%) on 2PT drives inside the arc, but an icy 3/16 (18.8%) from 3PT (1/9 vs Misfits 2). Contain his right-hand lane penetration first, contest pull-up 3s under control, and deny the pocket/kickout pass back to #9 Diallo.

tactical_keys.title: DO NOT HELP OFF #5 BRANDON NGUYEN IN THE CORNERS — SAG OFF NON-SHOOTERS #2 TROY & #6 RAJ INSTEAD!
tactical_keys.detail: #5 Brandon Nguyen just erupted for 14 PTS on 4/10 3PT (including the H1 buzzer-beater) with 0 turnovers across 4 games, and #10 Ty is 2/2 on corner 3s. Face-guard #5 Brandon on #9 Diallo drives! Your paint help MUST come from sagging off non-shooters #2 Troy (0 3PA) and #6 Raj / #7 Tashi (0 3PA combined).

tactical_keys.title: REVENGE GLASS ALERT ON #2 TROY + TRACK OFF-BALL CUTTERS (#4 LAZAR & #23 DILBAR)
tactical_keys.detail: #2 Troy wrecked CU for 23 PTS (10x 2PM) & 11 REB in the Mar 1 Championship and just returned in Week 4 (6 REB, 2 STL, 1 BLK). Put a body on #2 Troy every shot! Meanwhile, #4 Lazar (5/6 2PT = 83.3%) and #23 Dilbar (14 PTS on 6/8 FG vs Sapa Boys) feast on 45/baseline back-cuts when defenders ball-watch Diallo.

tactical_keys.title: UNLEASH CAMPBELL UNITED'S +12.8 1ST-HALF BLITZ & ATTACK #8 RADHIR / #6 RAJ FOUL TROUBLE
tactical_keys.detail: Latto Talent is a slow-starting team that has trailed or tied at halftime in ALL 4 games (-4.5 PPG in 1st Halves: 26-31 vs TMT, 30-35 vs RC, 31-39 vs SB, 33-33 vs MIS2). CU is D2's #1 1st-Half juggernaut! Push tempo early off stops, attack #8 Radhir (2.7 fouls/G) and #6 Raj (fouled out w/ 6 PF vs RC) to put CU in the bonus, and build a double-digit cushion before halftime!

personnel.name: Diallo Holmes
personnel.tendency: High-usage point-forward (braids + white headband) who rebounds & pushes coast-to-coast (6 AST in Wk 4), pulls up from three (3x 3PM in 3 of 4 games), and lives at the FT line (10/10 FT vs RC). Struggled to 1/6 2PT when walled off by Sapa Boys.
personnel.matchup_plan: Primary: #44 Christian Raslowsky / #4 Adam Fecteau. Run him off 3PT line into a disciplined 2-man chest wall in the paint — HANDS STRAIGHT UP (never reach, 88% FT!) — and finish every defensive board.

personnel.name: Sean Steven
personnel.tendency: Returning Champ guard who initiates offense, has 7 direct assists to #9 Diallo, and is automatic finishing right-hand drives in the lane (6/6 2PT last 2 games), while firing streaky high-volume 3s (1/9 vs MIS2).
personnel.matchup_plan: Primary: #7 Nick Switzer / #20 Shane Hoffman. Keep him out of the middle of the paint (100% 2PT!), contest pull-up 3s without flying past his hip, and blow up his pick-and-pop/kickout chemistry with #9 Diallo.

personnel.name: Brandon Nguyen
personnel.splits: 32 PTS in 4 GP (8, 6, 4, 14) • 6x 3PM (4/10 3PT in Wk 4!) • 2/2 FT • 0 Turnovers in 4 GP!
personnel.tendency: Returning Champ sharpshooter who relocate-drifts to the left/right corners when #9 Diallo or #1 Sean penetrates. Drained 4 triples (including the H1 buzzer-beater) vs Misfits 2 with zero turnovers all season.
personnel.matchup_plan: Primary: #12 Corey Randolph / #22 Matt Mocherman. LOCK & TRAIL — zero help/stunting off #5 Brandon in the corners! Force him to put the ball on the deck inside the arc.

personnel.name: Mahaan
personnel.tendency: Goggled mid-season wing addition who attacks closeouts hard (5/8 2PT, 4/5 FT) and buried the 62-59 go-ahead right-corner 3PT with 2:15 left vs Misfits 2.
personnel.matchup_plan: Primary: #16 Chris / #20 Shane Hoffman. Close out on balance to respect the corner 3, then absorb contact with your chest on straight-line drives.

personnel.name: Radhir
personnel.splits: 22 PTS in 3 GP (4, 8, 10) • 4x 3PM (2/8 3PT vs MIS2) • 3 STL, 1 BLK • 2.7 Fouls/G
personnel.tendency: Active wing shooter & passing-lane gambler (2 STL, 1 BLK, 2 AST in Wk 4, incl. the crunch-time swing pass to #3 Mahaan) who commits 2.7 fouls/game pressing ball-handlers.
personnel.matchup_plan: Close out short on wing catch-and-shoot 3s (2/8 3PT in Wk 4), protect cross-court passes, and attack him downhill early to pile up team fouls.

personnel.name: Lazar (w/ #23 Dilbar)
personnel.splits: #4 Lazar: 13 PTS (5/6 2PT = 83.3%, 0/2 3PT) • #23 Dilbar: 8.0 PPG (14 PTS on 6/8 FG, 2/2 3PT vs SB)
personnel.tendency: #4 Lazar thrives jumping passing lanes and cutting behind ball-watching defenders (4/5 2PT in Wk 4, 0/2 3PT). If #23 Dilbar suits up, respect his microwave scoring (14 PTS in Wk 3 vs Sapa Boys).
personnel.matchup_plan: Don't turn your head completely when #9 Diallo drives — keep vision on weak-side 45/baseline cuts, and make crisp two-hand perimeter passes.

personnel.name: Troy
personnel.role: REVENGE ALERT: Interior Paint Finisher & Glass Cleaner
personnel.splits: Wk 4 Return: 2 PTS, 6 REB, 2 STL, 1 BLK • MAR 1 CHAMP VS CU: 23 PTS (10x 2PM), 11 REB, 4 AST!
personnel.tendency: Athletic headband forward who DESTROYED Campbell United inside in the Winter '26 Final (23 PTS, 11 REB, 0 3PA) and just returned to the lineup in Week 4. Pure rim-runner, offensive rebounder, and shot-blocker.
personnel.matchup_plan: Primary: #9 Aaron / #24 George / #31 Evan. SAG INTO THE PAINT (0 3PA!) to wall off #9 Diallo, then HIT & BOX OUT #2 TROY on every single shot — zero second-chance putbacks!

personnel.name: Ty (w/ #6 Raj & #7 Tashi)
personnel.splits: #10 Ty: 2/2 3PT (100% in Wks 3-4) • #6 Raj: 3.7 PPG (5/5 2PT, 0 3PA, 6 PF foul-out vs RC)
personnel.tendency: #10 Ty spots up strictly in the corners (2/2 3PT off #9 Diallo skip passes). Reserve bigs #6 Raj and #7 Tashi never shoot 3s (0 3PA combined) and #6 Raj fouled out in 6 PF vs Ricecookers.
personnel.matchup_plan: Respect #10 Ty in the corners (contest catch-and-shoot), but sag all the way to the nail/paint whenever #6 Raj or #7 Tashi are on the floor!
